True Euphoria
I had been in a lot of stress all week and was going to a rave but was not in the mood for anything that I would trip on including E so I had a thought why not down some GHB to relax and mind you I am a completely experienced drug user but also somewhat of a junkie but had not taken anything even close to junk for aleast a week so I desided that it might be a good idea to just take a little something to help me out as my whole week was a mess so I took about 3.5g of the ghb in liquid form followed by 4mg insufflated hydromorphone which is an extremely small dose for me but I had not taken any for a week so I thought it should do the trick.
In about 20 min I felt a slight ghb like effect with a little something else to it that warm itchy feeling you first get with opiates so finally it was time to go to the rave.It took about 10 min to get there at which point I was feeling extremely pleasant sensations with some itching and fuzziness, when I got in the whole place was packed and did not feel to comfortable but I found a good place and sat down.It had been about 1hr sense I dosed and was feeling full effect but was quite sedated from the ghb.Finally my friends showed up and we started danceing which was not fun at all so I sat back down and became extremely hot and drank about 2 bottles of water which just made me feel sick so I left without my friends and took a walk this was extremely pleasurable and it was only 2hr since I dosed but I felt it was time to call it a night so I went home and went striaght to sleep but the whole next week I used the same combo with a little more hydromorphone each time and when I stoped I had no withdrawel at all which was really weird.All in all its better to just take each one on their own.
